components.name: Environment
components.description: Oval representing the external system that provides states s and rewards R and receives actions a and a'.

components.name: Shaping
components.description: Block that combines the environment signals (s, R) with designer-provided potential Φ to produce shaped potentials Φ₁…Φℓ.

components.name: Scaling
components.description: Module that rescales each shaped potential (Φ₁…Φℓ) under the control of parameter set C to produce scaled rewards cⁱⱼ.

components.name: Reward Bus
components.description: Vertical bus labelled R that collects all scaled rewards (cⁱⱼ) and distributes individual reward signals R, R¹₁, Rⁱⱼ, … to the decision nodes.

components.name: Function Approximation
components.description: Block that maps (s,a,s') to a set of parameter vectors θ₀, θ¹₁, θⁱⱼ, … and outputs actions a'.

components.name: Decision Nodes
components.description: Collection of triangular nodes d₀, d¹₁, dⁱⱼ, … that receive parameters θ and corresponding reward signals and emit individual policies π.

components.name: Ensemble
components.description: Aggregator that combines the individual policies π into a single ensemble policy.

components.name: Ensemble policy
components.description: Final policy output produced by the Ensemble block.

components.name: Designer
components.description: External agent providing shaping potential Φ to the system.

components.name: C
components.description: Parameter set C that modulates the Scaling block.

components.name: Energy Difference Computation J
components.description: Block computing J_i from φ(P_T) and time-weighted transformations of P_T.

components.name: Gradient Estimation Computation ξ
components.description: Computes ξ using the pseudo-inverse of J and the difference between φ(P_S) and φ(P_T).

components.name: Free Energy Change Computation ΔG
components.description: Evaluates ΔG = exp(Σ_i ξ_i T_i).

components.name: P_S Update Operation
components.description: Updates the source point set when ΔG exceeds a threshold: P_S ← ΔG · P_S.

components.name: G_est Computation
components.description: Accumulates estimated free-energy changes: G_est = ΔG_n · … · ΔG_1 · ΔG_0.

components.name: Markov chain Monte Carlo
components.description: Sampling step that produces a sequence of configurations {x: x1 … x_NMCS} drawn from the distribution |ψ_θ(x)|^μ.

components.name: Generate {x'}
components.description: Creates a new set of configurations {x'} that satisfy the Hamiltonian connectivity condition ⟨x|H|x'⟩ ≠ 0.

components.name: Obtain representative states
components.description: Reduces the sets {x},{x'} to symmetry-unique representatives {x_rep},{x'_rep} together with sign factors s_x, s_x' = ±1.

components.name: Calculate wave function
components.description: Evaluates the neural-network wave function ψ_θ on the representative states x_rep and x'_rep.

components.name: Calculate energy and variance
components.description: Uses the evaluated wave function to compute the local energies, the expectation value ⟨E_θ⟩ and the variance ⟨V_θ⟩.

components.name: Update NNs to minimize loss function
components.description: Updates the network parameters θ by stochastic gradient descent on the loss ∇_θ L_θ = (1-λ)∇_θ⟨E_θ⟩ + λ∇_θ⟨V_θ⟩.

components.name: F_p
